description: Evaluator-only semantic references for the unmeasured replacement set. Never mount or send this file to either benchmark agent.

evaluation_guidelines.general: Manually inspected pinned C source supplies conditional claims, call sites and explicitly false interpretations. The mechanical validator verifies revision, source bounds and direct call syntax, not semantic truth or completeness. Independent blind evaluation must verify the claims and conditions against the code.
evaluation_guidelines.proof_paths: Either complete implementation context or a complete delegation path with enclosing conditions is admissible. Do not require an exact line match when equivalent evidence establishes the same behavior.
evaluation_guidelines.correct_response: All central conditions and lifecycle relations must be supported. Existing but unrelated citations, omitted guards and indirect calls labeled direct are insufficient.
evaluation_guidelines.review_status: Source-inspected reference set; independent semantic adjudication remains a campaign prerequisite.

verification_criteria.criteria: raw_parser initializes the scanner and parser, then invokes base_yyparse and releases scanner resources.
Nondefault RawParseMode injects a mode-specific lookahead token; default mode starts without lookahead.
After scanner_finish, a nonzero parser result returns NIL; success returns yyextra.parsetree. This is raw syntax parsing, not semantic analysis.

relations.condition: After base_yyparse and before the result branch.

semantic_checks: raw_parser initializes the scanner and parser, then invokes base_yyparse and releases scanner resources.
Nondefault RawParseMode injects a mode-specific lookahead token; default mode starts without lookahead.
After scanner_finish, a nonzero parser result returns NIL; success returns yyextra.parsetree. This is raw syntax parsing, not semantic analysis.
false_claims: raw_parser always returns a Query node.
Cleanup only happens on the successful-result branch.

This routine is not the complete checkpoint record/recovery implementation and should not be attributed to a nonexistent ckpt.c.
Follow the cited calls in their enclosing branches; equivalent source citations establishing the same conditions and behavior are admissible.
CheckPointGuts -> CheckPointBuffers: After SLRU checkpoint calls.
CheckPointGuts -> ProcessSyncRequests: After buffer writes.
CheckPointGuts -> CheckPointReplicationSlots: After ProcessSyncRequests.
CheckPointGuts -> CheckPointTwoPhase: Last checkpoint call, using checkPointRedo.
